leastWorthwhile.text: The early sequence through the mouth, stomach and small intestine felt predictable, with only one combination offered each time, though the explanations were useful.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the supply network supports the hand, although the single available combination at each step made the decisions feel limited.
